Overview

Jacksonville is a city in FL with a population of 985,843. Florida’s largest city with beaches, no state income tax, and affordable living. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9a growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing.
